review.rationale: Primary material independently challenged for relevance, support, actionable usefulness and limits. Changing documentation is due for re-observation after 90 days; this cadence is review policy, not a guarantee.

reasons.relevance: Task-influenced graph ranking addresses repository code context; rules and tests remain outside the supported scope.
reasons.evidence: Official map and FAQ pages support definitions, adaptive map sizing and export; they do not establish embeddings or hard caps.
reasons.usefulness: The proposed map-only comparison records useful definitions, omissions, actual size and additional source reads on two tasks.
reasons.clarity: Limitations explicitly separate documented behavior, unrun trials, implementation omissions and unmeasured ranking quality.

need.query: Which maintained approach ranks repository code context for my current task?

claims.text: Aider maps repository files and selected definitions such as classes, functions and signatures. Its source-file dependency graph supplies ranking influenced by the current chat and map token budget.
The map token setting influences size but can expand adaptively; the FAQ documents map export with --show-repo-map.

candidates.name: Inspect a graph-ranked code map
candidates.reason: For a future authorized trial, use map-only output on a pinned public fixture and two real tasks. Record useful definitions, omitted dependencies, actual size and further source reads; compare with narrow file search without edits or model calls.
limitations: No candidate was executed. Maps omit implementation details and do not establish ranking of rules, commands or warnings. Token settings are not a guaranteed hard cap; graph ranking is not embedding-based semantic retrieval.
Documented capabilities acquired through primary-source research. Proposed trials have not been run; source support is separate from usefulness or comparative superiority.
